payload_json.loop: Two-button cast sequence: (1) cast Bladefall to rain blades at target location, leaving lingering blades on the ground around enemies; (2) cast Blade Blast to detonate all lingering blades in a chain of explosions — each detonation can mark further blades, emptying the queue at up to 30 detonations per second. Unleash Support maximises blades per cast; Spell Cascade drops additional volleys in front/behind target. Profane Bloom (Occultist ascendancy) chains explosions on cursed-enemy death for mapping.

anchor_quote: Unleash a torrent of blades with Bladefall to leave Lingering Blades surrounding your foes. Before they react, use Blade Blast to cause your Lingering Blades to explode dealing massive damage.

payload_json.geometry: Bladefall: stationary lingering blades positioned around targeted enemies at cast location (Spell Cascade extends front/behind). Blade Blast: explosion radius around each blade — overlapping explosions rewarded by AoE stacking via Concentrated Effect or Increased AoE. Explosion chains propagate across the blade field; radius scales with Increased Area of Effect Support.

anchor_quote: Concentrated Effect Support causes your lingering blades to fall within a concentrated area, allowing more overlapping explosions from Blade Blast.

payload_json.loop: Channel the skill while steering the cursor to project an illusion forward. The illusion travels at 130% of player movement speed along the cursor path, emitting pulse damage waves along its trajectory and accumulating stages. Releasing the channel teleports the player to the illusion's position and delivers a final damage burst scaled by stages accumulated. Considered channeled movement-attack hybrid.

anchor_quote: While Channeling this Skill you release an illusion of yourself that follows your cursor, emits damaging pulses, and accumulates stages. Upon ceasing the channel, you will teleport to the location of the illusion.

payload_json.geometry: Pulse damage emitted along the illusion's path (lane-shaped). Pulses cannot overlap — single-target damage is inherently limited. Teleport endpoint deals area damage at final position. Illusion constrained within range of player (~62 units max). Player considered stationary while channeling.

anchor_quote: The pulses cannot overlap, so the single-target Damage potential is rather limited.

payload_json.loop: Stand still and cast Crackling Lance continuously. Each cast gains 1 Intensity stack (max 3). Intensity grants 35% more damage with hits and ailments per stack, and +0.3m beam width per stack, but also narrows branching angle by 33% per stack — damage concentrates forward as intensity rises. Lose 1 Intensity every 0.5s while moving, or immediately on teleport. Requires stationary positioning to maintain ramp.

anchor_quote: Gain Intensify stacks by simply Casting your Spell continuously, but you will also quickly lose them upon moving or using a Movement Spell. 35% more Damage with Hits and Ailments per Intensity.

payload_json.geometry: Primary beam fires forward in a long trajectory, dealing lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front. Secondary branches angle outward from the primary beam catching enemies to the sides. At full Intensity (3 stacks): beam width +0.9m, branching angle compressed 99% — near-forward narrow beam. At zero Intensity: wide branching pattern covering broad frontal lane.

anchor_quote: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle. 33% less branching angle per Intensity; +0.3 metres to Beam Width Per Intensity.

payload_json.geometry: All triggered spells originate from self-position (player body). Area spells (Ice Spear, Freezing Pulse, VD, Forbidden Rite) radiate outward from player creating large-zone AoE coverage. Player walks forward to position center of damage zone. No manual aiming required.

payload_json.loop: Use Spell Totem or self-cast Summon Skeletons to populate the field with skeleton minions. Minion Life support gems on skeletons increase their life pool to amplify Dark Pact damage.

payload_json.geometry: Chain-hop delivery: chaos nova originates at skeleton position, chains to nearby skeletons. Each chain hop generates a new nova at the next skeleton. Coverage scales with number of skeletons and their distribution across the battlefield. When cast without skeletons: nova originates at player's own position (self-damage mode). Area of effect at each hop is small blast radius.

anchor_quote: The 6% removed life is added to the base damage so the skill does scale with minion life. The skill chains between skeletons when at least three are present, enabling area-of-effect coverage across enemy packs.
